Name: Jehoiada, the Priest
Summary: Jehoiada the priest hid Joash six years, took the captains of hundreds into covenant, crowned the boy king, had Athaliah slain, made a covenant that the people should be the LORD's, restored temple worship, and died at 130, buried among the kings for the good he had done.
KeyStory: In the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, brought out the king's son, crowned and anointed him, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.
RelatedPeople: Joash, King of Judah; Jehoshabeath, Daughter of Jehoram; Zechariah, Son of Jehoiada
LifeLesson: One priest's long faithfulness can preserve a nation and a promise.
